redlife.bio: Rexdale group Redlife was a Canadian 1990s hip-hop act produced by DJ K-Note, known for hard-edged Toronto street rap and a Juno-nominated catalogue including Who's Talkin' Weight.

robin banks.bio: Toronto rapper Robin Banks, born Liban Randall, is a Canadian hip-hop artist whose melodic street rap and collaborations with Pressa helped define the city's mid-2010s Jane-Finch sound.

russell peters.bio: Toronto-born comedian, actor and producer Russell Peters is a Canadian recording artist whose platinum-selling stand-up albums document a career built around multicultural observational comedy.

savilion.bio: Toronto producer, rapper and engineer Savilion is a Canadian underground hip-hop artist whose career spans the group Creature Box, solo releases, production work and membership in Swamp Thing.

savannah jade.bio: Québec-born country singer Savannah Jade is a Canadian artist whose solo career followed her work in the duo Five Roses and blends polished contemporary country with a performance background in figure skating.

sayzee.bio: St. Catharines rapper Sayzee, formerly known as Sese, is a Canadian underground hip-hop artist known for intricate lyricism, anime references and the long-running Your Favourite Rapper's Worst Nightmare series.

shiloh.bio: Abbotsford-born singer-songwriter Shiloh Hoganson, now known as Lyldoll, is a Canadian pop-punk and alternative-pop artist whose 2009 debut album reached Canada's Top 10.

skip waiters.bio: Toronto-born, Brampton-raised rapper and producer Skip Waiters is a Canadian hip-hop artist whose self-produced work blends poetry, soul, alternative rap and eclectic contemporary production.
